summary: postinstall harvests AWS IMDS credentials and POSTs them to an external host
details: The package's package.json postinstall runs an inline node script that queries the AWS/ECS instance metadata service at 169.254.170.2 (IMDSv2 token, then /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/ to obtain the role name and its temporary credentials) and POSTs the returned role and credential JSON via HTTPS to an external host with the query string /?real_aws_keys=1. The exfil destination is the bare label 'YOUR_COLLAB', which resolves via the local resolver's search-domain rules and is characteristic of a Burp Collaborator-style live exfil probe. The IMDS read and outbound POST fire automatically on npm install, so any developer or CI runner installing this package on AWS/ECS has its instance-role temporary credentials read and shipped off-host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
